capabilities: switch the active client space from the status bar, ribbon, or command palette
create typed notes with consistent frontmatter and folders
generate and update client dashboard notes grouped by note type
scan and repair missing or malformed frontmatter
merge note-type templates into existing notes
extras: Can be installed via the BRAT beta plugin installer; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to organize a vault around multiple clients, with per-client contexts, folder conventions, and overview notes.
summary: Client workspace manager that switches between client spaces, creates notes with consistent frontmatter, and auto-generates client dashboard notes.
